title-info.book-title: Tribulation of Myriad Races — Chapter 1353: Public invitation (2)

section.p: Zhao Li nodded, “We’ll do that. The final product might be unimaginably powerful. Even if it isn’t so powerful, it will be a heaven weapon or even an embryonic divine weapon. We need to be prepared for everything. Alright, I’ll leave and bring my senior brother here—”

“It’s fine.” Su Yu exhaled and said, “I don’t really want to go back, but since I’m the one asking for help, it’s only proper that I make the trip personally. I can’t be sending my invitation to Great Ming through a message, right?”
He had invited Old Zhao over through a message because the two were close enough for that. It wouldn’t be inappropriate. But that was not the case for the others.
Su Yu smiled and said, “Teacher, I’ll go now. Is Principal Zhao Tianbing in the Allheaven Battlefield currently?”
“Maybe?” Old Zhao was unsure. He said, “It’s fine. He will be able to reach faster than those from Great Ming.”
“Sure.”

Su Yu did not say more. Abruptly, the entire city shook. Then, the massive city vanished, sending massive waves in all directions. The many precious ships around the city were instantly crushed into pieces.
A pair of lovers were just walking through the city hand-in-hand moments ago. One of them had just stepped through the gate when the other vanished alongside the city.
The male, who was the one left alone outside the city, was sent flying for some distance before he yelled mournfully, “Su Yu! Why did you kidnap my lover? Where are you?”
All around him, people were regaining their balance from the sudden tsunami. They were all left quite speechless.
Fuck!
Could that bastard give them a warning before leaving?
Someone shouted, “My teacher is still in the city!”
“My grandpa is still inside as well! Where is he?”
Everyone was left feeling helpless. What now? Where did Su Yu go?

The experts of the nine realms sighed yet again. Damn it! They had given up on building an island. They had settled on boats. Why did Su Yu have to ruin even that? He was an asshole! Why couldn’t he give them a warning before leaving?

The city was definitely still somewhere in the Allheaven Battlefield. But nobody knew where it went. Lovers had been forcefully separated. Teachers and students had also been forcefully separated. Many started cursing Su Yu furiously.
Eastrift Valley.
Great Qin King opened his eyes abruptly.
Next, a massive city appeared above the Eastrift Valley. Then, Su Yu’s voice rang out.
“Su Yu of the Holy City Alliance offers his greeting, human Invincibles.”
Numerous people in the area noticed the massive floating city, including those in the Liu City.
Su Yu!
He had arrived with his ancient city.

Great Qin King took a step forward and appeared before the city. This was Su Yu’s very first time seeing Great Qin King for real. That was a tall middle-aged man with a stern, square face. His long hair was tied in a ponytail while the aura his body emitted was incomparably powerful. He did not look particularly handsome, but he looked dignified and imposing.

It was rumored that even prior to founding a prefecture, Great Qin King was already a regional overlord. At the time, the Human Realm was still under the rule of a feudal dynasty. Great Qin King was one of the barbarian kings during that era.
With an indifferent tone, Great Qin King asked, “Su Yu, why are you here with your ancient city?”

Su Yu coughed awkwardly before flashing a bright smile, “Great Qin King, do not misunderstand me. I’m not here to pick a fight. I’m here to invite a few people to my city. The journey might get dangerous so I’m here to pick them up personally.”
Great Qin King looked at Zhao Li, who was standing beside Su Yu. He was aware that Zhao Li had been picked up by a stone statue not long ago. Who was Su Yu inviting now?
Su Yu said, “Principal Niu, are you here?”

A short while later, Niu Baidao appeared with a rather dishevelled appearance. At his appearance, soft laughter erupted in the area. When Great Qin King saw Niu Baidao, he frowned, “As an Eternal, control yourself. At the very least, clean the lipstick marks on your face before appearing in public.”

Niu Baidao smiled as the lipstick marks on his face faded away. When he saw that everyone was still laughing at him, he said, “There is no need for you to be jealous. These marks were left by my wife. I was taking a break in the Allheaven Prefecture earlier. I had to rush over on short notice so I didn’t have the time to do much.”
He beamed at everyone and said, “We have been married for four hundred years yet we’re still as passionate as ever. You won’t understand.”
Were they laughing at him? He should be the one laughing at them instead.
Only then did he address Su Yu. With a surprised tone, he said, “Why are you here?”
Su Yu said, “Nothing much. I wish to invite Faculty Head Hu, Senior Hu Qi, and the other earth weaponsmiths of Great Ming to my city and talk about the dao of weaponsmithing.”
“Huh? Hu Xiansheng? He’s no weaponsmith…”

Su Yu explained, “Faculty Head Hu is proficient in the dao of space. The daos of space and weaponsmithing complement each other. Additionally, I might also need their advice for my upcoming weaponsmithing project.”
“Oh.” Niu Baidao nodded, “It’s no big deal. I’ll notify the prefect and get him to make the arrangements.”
Someone else asked, “Su Yu, you’re forging a weapon? Can this old man witness the process?”
When Su Yu looked over, he saw a white-haired old man. Heavenly Forge King.
Su Yu said, “You jest, Lord. You’re a heaven weaponsmith. How can a few earth weaponsmiths like us waste your time?”
Heavenly Forge King was rendered speechless. Why couldn’t the kid reject him directly? Why must the kid spin things around to make himself sound so righteous?

Su Yu had caused such a big ruckus to invite some earth weaponsmiths, including Zhao Li. He had also traded for some materials to forge heaven weapons from the myriad races not long ago. Was he planning to forge a heaven weapon?
Could he do it?

While Heavenly Forge King was deep in thought, Zhao Li said, “Can I trouble anyone to contact Zhao Tianbing of Great Zhou? Tell him I’m looking for him. Prefect Zhou, is Zhao Tianbing in seclusion lately?”
He was speaking to Zhou Polong.
After glancing at both Zhao Li and Su Yu, Zhou Polong nodded, “Sure. I’ll pass your message. He’s in Great Zhou. He will be here shortly.”
“Thank you, Prefect Zhou.”
Zhao Li cupped his hands and said nothing else.

A short while later, Great Qin King and the others vanished. As Su Yu was saying nothing else, the silence was somewhat awkward. Only a few people were left behind. Niu Baidao was one of them. Heavenly Forge King was also one of them. He was too curious to leave.
Before long, an old man appeared. It wasn’t Zhao Tianbing. Instead, it was Nan Wujiang. When Nan Wujiang’s gaze met Su Yu’s, the two stared at each other silently.
First Profound!
For a period of time, Su Yu had been rather close to First Profound. He would frequently tease and joke around with First Profound. But he no longer knew what to say to First Profound.

Nan Wujiang took a faceless mask out and tossed it over. He softly said, “This is an elder’s mask. An elder’s mask of the Profound Department. Take note that after Zhou Tianyuan’s departure, a new head has been assigned to the department. Try not to keep the mask on you outside your city.”
Su Yu caught the mask and slowly said, “Many thanks, Elder.”
Nan Wujiang didn’t know what to say. Su Yu was addressing him as the elder, not the great great grandteacher.
After a short silence, Nan Wujiang asked, “Yun Chen is a peak earth weaponsmith. Do you need his help?”
“No. Thanks for the offer.”
Nan Wujiang nodded. Slowly, his figure faded away. His voice rang out in Su Yu’s ears, “I still have a Third Profound mask on me. If you need me, feel free to contact me through the mask.”

Su Yu said nothing. Inwardly, he was feeling quite complicated. In truth, he didn’t feel too strongly about the two. However, his Teacher Liu couldn’t let go of this. Thus, he had to keep a certain attitude around the two as well.

It was likely that his martial uncle, Chen Yong, wouldn’t be able to let go of this as well. Since they couldn’t place their hatred on the two, they had opted to forever sever their relationship with the two.

Only then did Niu Baidao step forth with a smiling face. He did not bother to enter the city. He was quite scared of the stone statue. He said, “Su Yu, are you planning to forge a heaven weapon? You’re asking for quite a lot of people.”
Heavenly Forge King hurriedly offered, “I’m good at that!”
Su Yu was rendered speechless. Why was this old man so enthusiastic?
Did the old man not hear his words earlier?
Heavenly Forge King did not mind Su Yu’s expression. He said helplessly, “Su Yu, it has been thirty years since I last forged a heaven weapon. Do you know this?”
Su Yu stared at him wordlessly. He sighed and added, “I haven’t been able to collect enough materials. My title as a heaven weaponsmith feels empty.”
He was hinting at Su Yu to invite him into the project. Was Su Yu trying to forge a heaven weapon? That must be the case. He wouldn’t have asked for so many earth weaponsmiths otherwise.
Heavenly Forge King was desperately reminding Su Yu that he was good at that as well! He was the best at that in the human race!

Before Su Yu could say anything, Niu Baidao laughed and said, “Old Forge, just tend to your own matters. This is only an affair of some children. Why are you taking it so seriously? Go wait for Mystic Armor King. As long as you can catch him, you will have all the material you want.”
Niu Baidao had an extremely high seniority. After affirming his dao, he could be considered an equal of Heavenly Forge King in terms of status. Thus, he could speak casually with Heavenly Forge King.

Heavenly Forge King said, “Fine, fine. You youngsters will regret not seeking the help of a heaven weaponsmith like me. You will waste all those materials. This is no small matter. Wasting such valuable materials is a sin.”
Then, he vanished.
